mapper.select: select count(*) from t_groups_person a left join (select a.experiment_name, a.experiment_code, a.user_id from t_groups_person a where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.user_id = #{userId}) b on a.experiment_name = b.experiment_name and a.experiment_code = b.experiment_code where a.experiment_id = #{planId} and a.experiment_status = #{status}

select b.id from t_groups_person a left join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_name = b.experiment_name and a.experiment_code = b.experiment_code and b.is_deleted =0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN address IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN address = '0' THEN '未知' ELSE address END as name, COUNT(*) AS number FROM t_groups_person WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND groups_id= #{id} AND start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_groups_person WHERE is_deleted = 0 and end_time is not null and groups_id = #{groupId} AND DATE(end_time) = #{commonDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_groups_person WHERE is_deleted = 0 and end_time is not null and groups_id = #{groupId} and DATE(end_time) <= #{currentDay};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_groups_person tg WHERE is_deleted = 0 and tg.groups_id = #{groupId} AND tg.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tg.end_time IS NULL

SELECT su.id AS userId, su.username AS userName, tg.ip, tg.address, tg.start_time, tg.end_time FROM t_groups_person tg LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.is_deleted = 0 and tg.user_id = su.id WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and tg.experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND tg.groups_id = #{groupId}
select a.id from t_groups a left join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_id = b.id where b.is_deleted = 0 and a.is_deleted = 0 and b.experiment_status = #{status}
select a.user_id from t_groups_person a where a.groups_id = #{groupId} and a.is_deleted = 0
select groups_id from t_groups_person where is_deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId}
